ability.kogasa_addiction.aya.desc: Gain news value by recording new mob types, block types, and damage types; news value increases the equipment multiplier.
ability.kogasa_addiction.cirno.desc: Attacks can apply Slowness to targets and may also slow you. When durability runs out, growth can revive the item (revival can be disabled in config).
ability.kogasa_addiction.kogasa.desc: Each reinforcement level adds a bonus to the equipment overall multiplier.
ability.kogasa_addiction.koishi.desc: Melee attacks can critically hit. Ranged equipment uses separately configurable armor-piercing crits and special-target damage bonuses.
ability.kogasa_addiction.sakuya.desc: Attacks apply Instant Health or Instant Damage based on the target's creature type. The effect level is determined by the target's max health, making it particularly deadly against undead.
ability.kogasa_addiction.tenshi.desc: Armor records damage taken; for every quarter of the threshold reached, gain a corresponding level of Resistance. When full, the next hit deals extra damage based on a percentage of the target's max health and clears the record. Melee and ranged hits apply max-level Slowness and Mining Fatigue; deals extra damage to non-boss flying mobs. Every hit also randomly grants a stackable vanilla buff.

book.kogasa_addiction.entry.ability_ingo: Aya, Cirno, Koishi, Kogasa, Sakuya, and Tenshi Ingots correspond to the exclusive abilities of these six characters. Ability ingots are primarily used to infuse equipment at an anvil.

Their acquisition methods vary: Kogasa Ingots from blast furnaces; Aya Ingots from photography and shooting; Cirno Ingots from ice and snow; Koishi Ingots from reflecting fireballs at Ghasts; Tenshi Ingots from beacon bases at extreme heights; and Sakuya Ingots, hidden within coordinates that are divisible by time and space (see the respective ability chapters for details).
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.ability_slot: Equipment has one ability slot by default. When growth reaches a certain threshold, a second ability slot is unlocked; the default threshold is 50%.
Ability ingots can only be infused if the equipment does not already have the corresponding ability and has an available ability slot. The default infusion cost is 3 experience levels.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.admin_comman: The following commands require permission level 2 (typically administrator/OP). They are suitable for testing and troubleshooting and are not recommended for casual survival gameplay.

$(l)/kogasa info$(0): View detailed data of the main-hand equipment, including reinforcement, growth, multiplier, absorbed materials, enchantments, abilities, and ammo.$(br2)$(l)/kogasa grow <amount>$(0): Increase the main-hand equipment's growth value by the specified amount.$(br2)$(l)/kogasa reinforce <item>$(0): Simulate a reinforcement using the specified item (does not consume the item).$(br2)$(l)/kogasa reset$(0): Clear all reinforcement and growth data from the main-hand equipment.

Below are detailed descriptions of all available commands.$(br2)$(li)$(l)/kogasa info$(0): View detailed data of the main-hand equipment (reinforcement, growth, abilities, ammo, etc.).$(li)$(l)/kogasa grow <amount>$(0): Increase the equipment's growth value.$(li)$(l)/kogasa reinforce <item>$(0): Simulate a reinforcement using the specified item.

$(li)$(l)/kogasa reset$(0): Clear all reinforcement and growth data.$(li)$(l)/kogasa enchant <enchantment> <level>$(0): Directly add or overwrite an enchantment.$(li)$(l)/kogasa growenchant <count>$(0): Force trigger growth enchantment rolls.

$(li)$(l)/kogasa triggerenchant$(0): Grant growth enchantments based on current growth value.$(br2)[Ability Control]$(br)$(li)$(l)/kogasa addability <abilityID>$(0): Infuse an ability into the equipment.$(li)$(l)/kogasa removeability <abilityID>$(0): Remove an ability.$(li)$(l)/kogasa clearabilities$(0): Clear all abilities.

[Aya News Value]$(br)$(li)$(l)/kogasa newsvalue <amount>$(0): Add news value to Aya equipment.$(li)$(l)/kogasa setnewsvalue <value>$(0): Set the news value directly.$(br2)[Bow/Crossbow Potion Ammo]$(br)$(li)$(l)/kogasa setammo potion <potion>$(0): Load regular potion.$(li)$(l)/kogasa setammo splash <potion>$(0): Load splash potion.$(li)$(l)/kogasa setammo lingering <potion>$(0): Load lingering potion.

[Bow/Crossbow Special Ammo]$(br)$(li)$(l)/kogasa setammo firework$(0): Load firework ammo (requires holding a firework in the offhand).$(li)$(l)/kogasa clearammo$(0): Clear the loaded ammo.$(br2)[Misc]$(br)$(li)$(l)/kogasa resetfirstjoin$(0): Reset your own 'first join reward' status.
Combine an Aya Ingot with equipment in an anvil to infuse Aya's ability. Equipment with this ability records the types of mobs first defeated, block types first mined, and damage types first taken by the player, and gains News Value.
News Value contributes to the equipment's overall stat multiplier. Ranged hits can also trigger Speed and Haste effects; specific durations and levels are determined by config.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.aya_arrow.pa: The Aya Arrow is an exclusive arrow item usable by the Aya Bow or Aya Crossbow. The exclusive arrow entity will return the corresponding Aya Arrow item upon hitting a target (if pickup conditions allow).
Aya Arrows can be used with tipped arrow mechanics. Specific arrow recipes and available effects are subject to the recipes actually registered in the current version.
The Aya Arrow crafting recipe is shown here. Additionally, Aya Arrows can also be used to craft tipped arrows.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.cirno_abilit: Cirno's melee ability attempts to apply Slowness to the target and has a small chance to apply Slowness to the user as well. Specific chances, durations, and levels are determined by config. Ranged attacks do not apply Slowness to the user, and provide significant bonuses to tipped arrows.

When equipment with Cirno's ability is about to break from durability loss, the system consumes the specified growth value to prevent it from breaking during that instance. If there is insufficient growth value, the equipment breaks normally. The revival feature can be disabled in config.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.equipment_in: Current equipment includes the Kogasa sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, and hoe; the Tenshi helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots; and the Aya bow, crossbow, and arrow. They share a unified growth-equipment data structure.

The specific effects of reinforcement and growth on stats depend on the equipment type and configs. View the item tooltip to learn about the current equipment's actual multiplier, reinforcement, growth, and ability information.
The Kogasa Sword crafting recipe is shown here. Other equipment recipes are similar; please query the recipe book and JEI for specifics.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.growth.name: Growth System
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.growth.page1: Growth value is stored within the data of individual equipment pieces, not as a global player level. Whether growth is unlocked depends on the equipment's reinforcement count and config settings.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.growth.page2: Currently supported growth sources include: attacking entities, breaking blocks, tool actions (axe stripping, shovel flattening, hoe tilling, bow/crossbow firing), and Kogasa armor worn when taking damage.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.growth.page3: Accumulating growth value grants a series of rewards. These include: stat increases for the equipment, growth enchantments, and unlocking ability slots and reinforcement slots.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.growth_encha: Growth enchantments are a new enchantment acquisition mechanic introduced by this mod. Their max level is the vanilla max level + 1, and they ignore vanilla enchantment conflict rules.

Growth enchantments trigger when the equipment's growth value reaches a config-defined threshold. Upon triggering, it randomly selects an existing enchantment that has not reached (vanilla max level + 1) and increases its level. If all enchantments have reached their limits, it attempts to grant a new enchantment; otherwise, a message pops up indicating that growth enchantments have reached their limit.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.introduction: Welcome to Kogasa's Growth Equipment Manual
This mod introduces growth, reinforcement, absorption, and character ability systems to certain weapons, tools, armor, and ranged equipment. This manual explains how these mechanics work together.
Specific equipment values are affected by config files. If a server administrator has adjusted the configs, please refer to the actual in-game display and server rules.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.kogasa_abili: Kogasa's ability grants an additional overall multiplier based on the reinforcement level.
The ranged hit streak effect is also controlled by independent configs. Please refer to your current config for specific bonuses, streak reset time, and max streak count.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.koishi_abili: Koishi's ability has a high chance to trigger critical hits. Ranged weapons also have armor-piercing capabilities and can deal additional damage to targets that are immune to arrows.

Obtaining Koishi Ingots is related to the number of Ghasts killed by reflecting fireballs while invisible. By default, killing 2 Ghasts grants 1 Koishi Ingot. By the way, the ghasts from Twilight Forest are also counted.
1. Craft or obtain a piece of equipment from this mod.$(br)(Under default configs, you will be given a piece of equipment with a random ability upon first joining the world)$(br)2. Reinforce the equipment in an anvil using materials of the same category.$(br)3. Once the config-defined reinforcement count is reached, the equipment can accumulate growth through eligible actions.

4. Place the equipment and an ability ingot into an anvil to infuse the corresponding character ability.$(br)5. Hold the modifier key on the item tooltip to view growth, reinforcement, and ability information.$(br)6. Use the mod's commands to view detailed equipment data, or for debugging and troubleshooting.$(br)7. Most features of this mod can be toggled or adjusted in the config file.$(br)Wishing you a pleasant forging journey in Gensokyo!
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.ranged_basic: The Aya Bow and Aya Crossbow maintain the primary operation methods of vanilla bows and crossbows, while being integrated into the unified data system as growable equipment. Bow draw states, crossbow charge states, and enchantments are still handled by their respective vanilla mechanics.

Ranged abilities include Aya's Speed/Haste on hit, Cirno's Slowness effect, Koishi's ranged crits, and Kogasa's hit streak bonus. Specific behaviors depend on the abilities infused into the equipment and configs.

The Aya Crossbow crafting recipe is shown here. The Aya Bow recipe is similar, replacing the sticks in the vanilla bow/crossbow recipe with Aya Ingots. Please query the recipe book and JEI for specifics.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.reinforcemen: Place the equipment on the left side of the anvil, and a valid material of the same category on the right side (bows and crossbows can be reinforced with 16 arrows, and arrows do not count towards the material duplication limit). Upon success, the equipment's reinforcement level increases and it absorbs a portion of the material's base value into its own stats.

The registry ID of reinforcement materials is recorded. The same equipment cannot use the same registered item as an absorption material twice, nor can it absorb itself. Reinforcement limits, experience costs, and absorption ratios can be adjusted via config.
When reinforcing equipment at an anvil, place the equipment on the left side and a valid reinforcement material on the right side. For specific information, please query JEI.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.sakuya_abili: Obtaining a Sakuya Ingot is tied to time and space. At the start of each in-game day, the system concatenates the player's floored X, Z, and Y coordinates into a single string and sums all its digits. If the sum is divisible by 3, there is a high chance to receive a Sakuya Ingot.

When infused into equipment via an anvil, attacks will apply Instant Health or Instant Damage depending on whether the target is undead. You can also activate a time stop ability by pressing X (or any other key you've set).

Applying Instant Health to undead mobs (like Zombies and Skeletons) causes severe damage; applying Instant Damage to non-undead mobs (like Spiders and Creepers) delivers a burst strike. This is an extremely effective tactic against high-health targets.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.sakuya_knife: Sakuya Knife is a trident-like weapon that excels at both ranged and melee combat. As such, it can undergo absorption with a trident, and it can also use any sword item.

Sakuya Knife has no durability limit and a maximum stack size of 3, but each throw has a chance to break it. A broken knife can be repaired in an anvil by combining it with a Sakuya Ingot, while retaining all data. Increasing its growth value reduces this chance, but even at the maximum growth value, there is still a small chance of breaking.
This is the crafting recipe for Sakuya's Knife.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.tenshi_abili: Tenshi: Girl of the Non-Thinker, Non-Non-Thinker

Wearing armor with Tenshi's ability accumulates damage taken into a 'State of No-Thought, No-Mind'. For every quarter of the threshold reached (rounded up), gain one level of Resistance; single-hit overflow exceeding the threshold is not recorded.

Once the threshold is reached, the next hit deals extra damage based on the configured percentage (default 10%%) of the target's max health, then clears the record. The record resets to zero upon death or when Cirno's equipment revival ability triggers.

Melee or ranged hits apply max-level Slowness and Mining Fatigue; non-boss flying mobs take increased damage based on a configured multiplier (default 2x). Every hit also randomly grants a vanilla buff: each time adding 10 seconds and increasing the level by 1, up to a max duration of 60 seconds and a max level of IV. Tenshi arrows are guaranteed to hit their targets.
book.kogasa_addiction.entry.troubleshoot: Anvil reinforcement related: Confirm the left side is a mod equipment piece, the right side material belongs to the correct tag category, and that this item type hasn't been absorbed by this equipment before. If issues persist, query JEI for reinforcement recipes.
Growth related: Confirm the growth value is sufficient to trigger growth enchantments or unlock ability slots. If it doesn't trigger when it should, try using commands like /kogasa triggerenchant.
If you encounter other issues, please consult this book and the config file first. If the problem persists, contact the mod author or seek help in the mod community.
book.kogasa_addiction.kogasa_manual.land: Welcome to Kogasa's Growth Equipment Manual! $(br2)This manual covers equipment growth, anvil reinforcement, material absorption, character abilities, ranged weapons, and administrator debugging tools. Most values can be modified via config files; please refer to in-game behavior as the final standard.
